name: Faerie Fire
summary: Outlines objects and creatures in a 20-foot Cube; attacks against them have Advantage and they can't be Invisible.
text: Choose a 20-foot Cube within range and a color: blue, green or violet. Every object in the Cube is outlined in that light, and each creature in it is outlined too unless it succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, outlined creatures and objects shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius, gain no benefit from the Invisible condition, and attack rolls against them have Advantage if the attacker can see them. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
